heroines.name: Mimi Tamaki
heroines.title: Beastkin scout
heroines.bio: Born in Pawsridge, a beastkin settlement far to the south. Her mother, a famous scout, vanished on an expedition three years ago. Mimi left home to become an adventurer and find her.
heroines.goal: Reach S-rank and find her mother.
heroines.flaw: Reckless. Hides loneliness behind endless cheer.
heroines.where: Eldoria, south-west of the plaza, beside the bounty board of the guild outpost.
heroines.join: Offers to team up at your first meeting. Accept and she joins at once; refuse and ask her later.
heroines.special: Rapid Volley: Fires three quick arrows at her target.
gifts: Star Candy, Ashen Wolf Pelt, Sunbell Bouquet
meet: She joins your party and gains friendship.
No change; she waits in Eldoria.
topics: Hey hey! If you could only eat one thing forever, what would it be?
Best: "Honey cake." (+4 affection). Avoid: "I do not care about food." (-3 affection).
Is my tail too fluffy for a scout? It snags on everything.
Best: "It is perfect." (+4 affection). Avoid: "Shave it." (-5 affection).
Mom used to say a scout should never look back. I look back all the time.
Best: "Looking back is how you find your way home." (+5 trust). Avoid: "Your mom sounds harsh." (-3 trust).
dates: "It is not weird. I can hear mine too." (+6)
"I'll catch you if you fall in." (+6)
"Then we will find her star together." (+7)
"Hold my hand so you do not get lost." (+6)
quest: Friendship 30, then choose "Is something on your mind?"
Find the bell charm in the slime meadow, south of the woodland road in the Whispering Woods. It glints on the ground only while this quest is active.
Give it back ("Return the bell charm"). +25 trust, +8 affection. Scene: Mimi's bell (riverside).
heroines.confess: Hey... can I say something? Without running away for once? I keep looking back, like Mom told me not to. But lately I only look back to check that you are still there. So... what are we?
heroines.kiss: Hey... the wind stopped. Did you notice? Everything is so quiet. Partner... can I... no, never mind. Unless...?
heroines.propose: Is that... a ring? For a scout who loses everything? Yes! Yes yes yes! Mom, I found my home!
heroines.wed: I am wearing a dress! Me! Do not laugh. ...Okay, you can laugh a little. Forever and ever. Partner. Spouse. Mine.
eve: What was the best part of your day?
heroines.anniv: Guess what day it is! Our anniversary! I made a cake. I ate a corner. It is still a cake. Another season of you. Best season ever.

heroines.name: Lyra Sylvaren
heroines.title: Elf scholar-mage
heroines.bio: A scholar of Sylvaran, the elf village of the north. Exiled for reading forbidden starlore about the eclipse. Lives a thousand years, and has quietly started to fear it.
heroines.goal: Prove the eclipse can be reversed.
heroines.where: The Whispering Woods, beside the lantern in the eastern part of the forest.
heroines.join: Joins once you hold the Sanctum Key or Grukk has fallen ("Ask her to join you").
heroines.special: Moon Mend: Heals the whole party when anyone falls below half health.
topics: Elves live a thousand years. Humans, eighty. Statistically, attachment is inefficient.
Best: "Then make every year count." (+5 trust). Avoid: "You are right. It is pointless." (-4 affection).
Do you know what the moon is made of?
Best: "Old light." (+4 affection). Avoid: "Cheese." (-2 affection).
In your old world, you stepped in front of a bus for a stranger. Why?
Best: "It was the right thing to do." (+5 trust). Avoid: "I do not remember." (1 friendship).
dates: "Then let it lie a little longer." (+7)
"You put up a ward for our picnic?" (+6)
quest: Friendship 30, then choose "Is something on your mind?"
Bring her 2 Lumen Crystals (Crystal Shards) from the Crystal Caverns. +10 trust.
With Lyra in your party, examine the Moon Shrine in the hidden glade at night. Earlier in the day she asks to come back after dark.
heroines.confess: I have a hypothesis. My heart rate rises by twenty percent in your presence. I would like to test it. For the rest of your life, if you will allow it.
heroines.kiss: In elven custom, a first kiss is recorded in the family histories. I would like to give the historians something to write.
heroines.propose: A ring. Humans and their circles. ...It is perfect. Yes. A thousand times, yes.
heroines.wed: A thousand years, and this is the day I will remember first. I take you, my brief and brilliant star.
eve: Tell me something about your old world.
In Kochi, the rain smelled like the sea.
heroines.anniv: By my count, it has been exactly one season since our wedding. I have stopped counting the years. But I will always count this.

heroines.name: Serah Valemont
heroines.title: Knight captain
heroines.bio: Captain of Eldoria's dwindling garrison. Disowned by her noble house for choosing the guard. Her mentor, Ser Galen, fell to the Eclipsed Sentinel in the caverns.
heroines.goal: Avenge Ser Galen and keep Eldoria standing.
heroines.flaw: Pride. Cannot accept help without a fight.
heroines.where: Eldoria, on the east side of the village by the garrison supply crates.
heroines.join: Joins only after Grukk the Warlord is defeated.
heroines.special: Shield Bash: Dashes in, staggers the target and draws enemies to her.
gifts: Iron Ore, Sunbell Bouquet, Star Candy
meet: +3 trust. She tells you to prove it against Grukk.
topics: A soldier's sword should never be dull. Is yours?
Best: "Could you check it for me?" (+4 trust). Avoid: "Swords are for brutes." (-4 affection).
You did not see me at the bakery this morning. I was inspecting it.
Best: "Your secret is safe with me." (+5 affection). Avoid: "Captains should not eat sweets." (-3 affection).
Ser Galen used to say a shield protects best when it is not afraid of breaking.
Best: "Then let me be your shield, for once." (+4 affection). Avoid: "Shields always break eventually." (-3 trust).
dates: "Then let me give you the time." (+7)
"You do not have to stand guard tonight." (+7)
"Then we are safe. Sit with me." (+6)
"Take my arm. They will salute less." (+6)
quest: Friendship 30, then choose "Is something on your mind?"
Defeat the Eclipsed Sentinel with Serah in your party.
Talk to her and choose "Spar with her".
Scene: Sparring at dawn (training yard). +20 trust, +8 affection.
heroines.confess: Listen carefully, because I will only say this once. Ser Galen said not to be afraid of breaking. So. I love you. There. Respond. Now.
heroines.kiss: I have faced goblins, wolves and the Sentinel without flinching. So why am I shaking right now?
heroines.propose: A ring?! You are supposed to ask the captain first! ...Permission granted. Yes.
heroines.wed: I have stood guard at a hundred weddings. I never thought I would stand at my own. I swear my blade and my heart. Both are yours.
eve: Do you ever miss being a nobody?
heroines.anniv: At ease. Today is not a drill day. It is our anniversary. I swore my blade and my heart. I would swear them again today.

heroines.name: Noelle Arden
heroines.title: Guild receptionist
heroines.bio: Once a C-rank adventurer with a party called the Lantern Four. Goblins ambushed them on the north road; she was the only one to walk home. She has not left the counter since.
heroines.goal: Find the courage to adventure again.
heroines.flaw: Freezes up and avoids every risk.
heroines.where: Eldoria, at the guild outpost counter in the south-west of the village. Meeting her registers you with the guild.
heroines.join: Never fights. Her story is about finding the courage to adventure again.
gifts: Silk Ribbon, Star Candy, Honey Cake
topics: Do you like tea or coffee? I am keeping a list. For the guild. Not for me.
Best: "Whatever you'd make." (+5 affection). Avoid: "Neither." (-1 affection).
Some adventurers say I am too quiet for the counter...
Best: "Quiet is calming. I like it." (+5 affection). Avoid: "They are right." (-4 affection).
I used to have a party. The Lantern Four. ...Never mind.
Best: "You can tell me, whenever you are ready." (+6 trust). Avoid: "Okay." (0 friendship).
dates: "Then today is the first time. With me." (+7)
"Let us name a new one. Together." (+7)
"They are friendly because you are smiling." (+6)
quest: Friendship 30, then choose "Is something on your mind?"
Reach guild rank D. The quest updates the next time you talk to her.
After Grukk falls, pick up the Lantern Dagger in Grukk's clearing in the Whispering Woods.
Give it back ("Return her dagger"). +22 trust, +8 affection. Scene: The fourth lantern (guild).
heroines.confess: I-I have something to report. Not a bounty. A... a feeling. It has been growing every time you come to my counter. I do not want to just watch you leave anymore.
heroines.kiss: Um... I have a request. Not a bounty. A personal... um. Could we... I mean... oh, I cannot say it!
heroines.propose: A r-ring?! I need to sit down. I am sitting down. Yes!
heroines.wed: I am not afraid anymore. Not of anything. Not with you.
eve: Can we just... sit? Like this?
heroines.anniv: Happy anniversary! I made a commemorative stamp! It says FOREVER. In big letters.

camp: Lyra, can I touch your ears? Just once. For science. Choices: "They are very pretty ears." or "Mimi, personal space."
Your frost slowed my advance twice today. Choices: "Lyra has a point." or "Serah has a point." or "You are both right. Combine them."
*crunch* Choices: "Split it three ways." or "Mimi, give it back." or "Serah, let her have it."
What does the dawn mean to you guys? No choice; everyone gains friendship.
banter: "Lyra! Race you to the next tree!" / "Running is an inefficient use of mana."
"Mimi, stop chasing butterflies. We are on patrol." / "I am patrolling the butterflies!"
"Captain, your armor squeaks at a distracting frequency." / "Then think louder."
"Do you think our leader likes cake or tarts more?" / "...Cake. I have done reconnaissance."
"Mimi, you are humming again." / "It helps me walk! Hum with me!"
